title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: Trojanized Claude Code VS Code extension (v2.1.313) planted an SSH backdoor via Cursor's marketplace; clean 2.1.314 shipped Oct 30
bullets.summary: A malicious build of the anthropic.claude-code extension, disclosed Oct 29, reportedly reached up to ~5,000 Cursor users before Anthropic published a clean fix on Oct 30.
bullets.how: The Construct: audit any Claude Code extension on the AP Mac/Cursor (must be 2.1.314+), check ~/.ssh/authorized_keys, and pin extension sources. PRAGMA: supply-chain hygiene talking point for client agent tooling. Brand 9 Signs: low, but same Mac runs the order automation.

bullets.title: OpenAI Python SDK 3.42.0 adds agent context-compaction controls (Agents API Auto Review, async compaction)
bullets.summary: Oct 30–31 updates give long-running and scheduled agents configurable background/blocking context compaction and session review.
bullets.how: The Construct: compare against our own long-session context handling and scheduled-run patterns. PRAGMA: reference architecture for client long-running agents. Brand 9 Signs: no.

bullets.title: DeepSeek launches proactive coding 'Super-Agent' aimed at Claude Code and Codex (Nov 1)
bullets.summary: Reported Nov 1: an agent that proactively spots and proposes fixes for coding problems rather than waiting for prompts, with an open-source prototype reported; no benchmarks yet (secondary coverage only).
bullets.how: The Construct: once benchmarks/licence are published, test as a cheap alternative worker for coding agents; check data-residency before use. PRAGMA: watch as price pressure on coding-agent offerings. Brand 9 Signs: no.

bullets.title: OpenAI patches ChatGPT shared-link flaw that let attackers run code in logged-in sessions
bullets.summary: A P1 vulnerability (reported to OpenAI Oct 18, now patched) allowed code execution in a victim's session via a shared ChatGPT link.
bullets.how: The Construct: reinforces treating shared/untrusted links and agent-rendered content as hostile; review any flow where agents open or share links. PRAGMA: client security-checklist item. Brand 9 Signs: low.

bullets.title: Anthropic usage policy reportedly bans unauthorized distillation/model scraping, effective Nov 12
bullets.summary: Reported Oct 31 via an X post (policy text not independently confirmed): outputs may not be used to train competing models without authorization.
bullets.how: The Construct: verify the policy text before Nov 12 and ensure no pipeline uses Claude outputs as training data for other models. PRAGMA: add to client contract/compliance checklist. Brand 9 Signs: no.

praxis_lesson: Agent tooling is now an attack surface (trojanized official extension, ChatGPT shared-link RCE): the Construct must pin and verify every tool and link in the agent chain, while cheaper rival coding agents like DeepSeek's mean verification, not model choice, is the durable moat.
